title: ReQOR: Operator-Discrepancy Subspace Repair for Quantization-Conditioned Backdoors in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32755v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantization-Conditioned Backdoors (QCBs) cause large language models (LLMs) to exhibit malicious behavior after quantization while remaining benign at high precision. Existing defenses often rely on security-guided configuration selection or iterative optimization, but do not identify which quantization-induced changes should be repaired. We isolate module-local quantization effects from upstream drift by evaluating the high-precision and quantized versions of each module on identical states from the quantized inference trajectory, and formulate QCB defense as repairing the resulting same-state operator discrepancies. We propose ReQOR, a training-free defense that identifies the dominant directions of these discrepancies on benign calibration data and restores the full-precision computation along them in closed form, yielding a factorized residual adapter. translated_title: ReQOR：面向大语言模型量化条件后门的算子差异子空间修复
translated_abstract: 量化条件后门会使大语言模型在量化后表现出恶意行为，而在高精度状态下保持良性。现有防御方法通常依赖安全导向的配置选择或迭代优化，但未能识别哪些由量化引发的变化应当被修复。我们通过在来自量化推理轨迹的相同状态上评估每个模块的高精度版本与量化版本，将模块局部的量化效应与上游漂移分离，并将量化条件后门防御形式化为修复由此产生的同状态算子差异。我们提出ReQOR，一种无需训练的防御方法，它在良性校准数据上识别这些差异的主导方向，并以闭式形式沿这些方向恢复全精度计算，从而产生一个因子化的残差适配器。ReQOR既不使用攻击信息，也不使用基于梯度的优化，并支持……
tldr: ReQOR提出了一种无需训练的防御方法，通过在良性校准数据上识别模块级量化算子差异的主导方向，并以闭式形式恢复全精度计算，有效修复大语言模型中的量化条件后门。
en_tdlr: ReQOR is a training-free defense that repairs quantization-conditioned backdoors in LLMs by identifying the dominant directions of same-state operator discrepancies on benign calibration data and restoring full-precision computation along them in closed form.
